nodes.title: Deep-kind audit of data/kits: 7697 items tagged error_spot / predict / why / contrast / near_transfer / far_transfer / translate_rep (teachback excluded), each read by taxila-brain (gpt-5.6-sol, effort medium) and DeepSeek-V4-Pro on the SIN account; 15394 calls, 0 unresolved failures. Both models say shallow (recall, story detail, one step, read-off, move absent): 1941 (25.2%). By kind: error_spot 25/1043 (2.4%), predict 288/1246 (23.1%), why 250/1292 (19.3%), contrast 433/1204 (36.0%), near_transfer 513/1331 (38.5%), far_transfer 200/794 (25.2%), translate_rep 232/787 (29.5%). By class it falls from 54.5% (class 1) to 14.4% (class 9); Hindi 41.0% and English 33.4% are the highest subjects. The models split on 33.9% (agreement 0.661, kappa 0.315); B is the more lenient (1753 B-only vs 855 A-only shallow). Human read (one rater), 112 items: 4 of 60 agreed-shallow and 2 of 30 agreed-deep disagreed (6.7% each); all 25 agreed-shallow error_spot read, 12 of 25 disagreed, all of them a stated false claim refuted from a fact, which the rubric's error_spot move calls deep (a rubric boundary). Apply set 1927 (1941 minus 14 overruled). Skills keeping a real deep item: 2787 -> 2482 of 2987. Agent evidence read (read.js, bar 0.8): practice right + error_spot right = 0.816 understood; the same with the error_spot plain = 0.715 partly.

nodes.title: PROPOSED (patch docs/research/kits/deep-kind-fix-2026-10-15.patch, not applied). A deep-tagged kit item that both cross-family models read as shallow, and that the human read did not overrule, carries the optional field deep: false. Its kind, key, acceptable forms, hints, verified, classifier target, pose and Director selection all stay. Only its ANSWER is plain evidence. evidenceFrom uses evidenceProbeFor -> P15 (item.open by the ladder): no U / T facet, no generative pass, no errorspot / transfer delayed check, 'practice' in the parent report. No migration, because cls is already in kt_evidence. A why-kind item's answer never comes back as a volunteered probe.why. The agent evidence read uses the plain table for a graded entry marked plain. earnedRead / deepAvailable / untested / offeredItems count only real deep items. The loader passes the field through. 1927 items (evals/kit-deep-kinds/apply.mjs --write). Not a retag, because kind also picks the grading path (why: open target and the held blind grader) and the pose. A deep: false why item's evidence verdict becomes the turn's classifier label, as for practice.
nodes.reversal: a second human read, or a re-run with another rubric / model pair, overrules more than 10% of the apply set; or child response data (TEST traces, a DECIDED sim lab keyed on the same predicate) show partly children pass deep: false items no more often than the unmarked deep items of the same kind, or under-reads of understood rise more than the over-reads removed; or the kits are re-authored so kind matches demand (then the field goes)

nodes.title: deep: false fixes the evidence weight only. Three gaps remain. (1) The 13 shallow error_spot items are still posed as 'your own working with one planted mistake' (shapes.js KIND_NOTE), predict items still open engines in predict mode, and why-kind items still skip the follow-up why. A re-tag needs blind-solver re-verification of the keys. (2) 2608 split items (33.9%) stay deep unread; B-only splits are 2x A-only. (3) The rubric's error_spot boundary (refuting a stated false claim from a fact) needs an owner call. The cited sim-lab item 'पायल कैसी आवाज़ करती थी?' (c2-hindi-ch03-t01-i02) is tagged practice in this tree; its siblings i07 (predict) and i11 (why) are in the apply set.

md.decisions:
## dc-r143-kit-deep-false (2026-10-15, PROPOSED)

**What:** a deep-tagged kit item that is recall, one step or read-off carries the optional field `deep: false`.

- What stays: its kind, key, grading and pose.
- What changes: its answer counts as plain evidence.
  - KT: `evidenceProbeFor` gives P15, so the answer is `item.open`: no U / T facet and no generative pass.
  - Agent lane: the evidence read uses the plain table, and `earnedRead`, `deepAvailable` and `offeredItems` count only real deep items.
- Set: 1927 items, where both cross-family models agree and the human read does not overrule (`docs/research/kits/DEEP-KIND-AUDIT.md`).
- How: patch `docs/research/kits/deep-kind-fix-2026-10-15.patch`, then mark the kits with `evals/kit-deep-kinds/apply.mjs --write`.

**Why:**

- One shallow "deep" right answer moves U past 0.6 (why) or T past 0.6 (far transfer). It can make a skill `learned_today`.
- On the agent lane it lifts the evidence read from 0.715 (partly) to 0.816 (understood).
- Retagging the kind would also change the grading path (a why item gets open grading and the held blind grader) and the teacher's pose. Its keys were verified as posed.
- The probe-to-class route needs no migration.

**Reversal:**

- a second human read, or another rubric / model pair, overrules more than 10% of the set;
- child data show `deep: false` items are no easier for partly children than real deep items, or under-reads rise more than the over-reads removed;
- the kits are re-authored so that kind matches demand.
md.measurements:
## ms-r143-kit-deep-kinds (2026-10-15)

- **Scope:** 7697 deep-tagged items, each read by taxila-brain and DeepSeek-V4-Pro. 15394 calls, 0 unresolved failures.
- **Both shallow:** 1941 (25.2%).
  - error_spot 2.4%, predict 23.1%, why 19.3%;
  - contrast 36.0%, near transfer 38.5%, far transfer 25.2%, translate_rep 29.5%.
- **By class and subject:** from 54.5% in class 1 to 14.4% in class 9. Hindi 41.0%, English 33.4%.
- **Model agreement:** split 33.9%, kappa 0.315.
- **Human read (112 items):**
  - sample: 4/60 agreed-shallow and 2/30 agreed-deep disagreed;
  - error_spot census: 12/25 disagreed, all "refute a stated false claim from a fact".
- **Apply set:** 1927.
- **Skills with a real deep item:** 2787 -> 2482 of 2987.
- **Tests (scratch copy of f444f064):** 5/5 new pass. 808 -> 813 existing tests with the same 12 environment failures in both trees.
md.open:
## open-r143-kit-kind-pose-mismatch (2026-10-15)

`deep: false` fixes the evidence weight only.

- **Pose:** shallow error_spot items keep the planted-mistake pose. Predict items keep the predict engine mode. Why-kind items skip the follow-up why. A re-tag needs blind-solver re-verification.
- **Split items:** 2608 (33.9%) stay deep unread.
- **Error_spot boundary:** whether refuting a stated false claim from a fact counts as error_spot (12 of 25) needs an owner call.
